notes: Life OS is a daily-use PWA, so no immersive loader (GetLayers guidance for app shells). Font: Manrope from the GetLayers catalogue, self-hosted in assets/fonts so it works offline. Meridian runs from js/ui/meridian.js (shader and motion unchanged from the master; CONFIG only, palette BRAND). Buttons borrow Aerra's sheen + arrow tile and Relay's clockwise ring; entrances use the house blur-rise reveal. Colours are the owner's brand palette: white for light mode, black for dark mode, #0071e3 as the only accent (lifted to #2997ff for light on the dark stages and blue text in dark mode), the greys kept minimal. All tokens live in css/tokens.css.
